parameters.name: FromType
parameters.description: The source channel through which the user connects. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The remarks or application description for the SMS template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is SMS. Maximum length: 100 characters.

parameters.name: SmsContent
parameters.description: The body content of the SMS template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is SMS. Length: 2 to 400 characters.

parameters.name: SmsType
parameters.description: The business type of the SMS template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is SMS.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. Maximum length: 30 characters.

parameters.name: TemplateNickName
parameters.description: The nickname of the template or the alias of the sender. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is email. Maximum length: 30 characters.

parameters.name: TemplateSubject
parameters.description: The subject of the email template. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is email. Maximum length: 256 characters.

parameters.name: TemplateText
parameters.description: The body content of the email. This parameter is required only when the templatetype is email. Maximum size: 1 MB.
